answer_1.quote: For the second goal, idea verbalization, is carried out after idea exploration to generate fluent and reasonable texts describing an idea, which usually comprises new contents derived from the combination of two different concepts.
answer_1.outputs: fluent and reasonable texts describing an idea derived from the combination of two different concepts

answer_2.quote: Similar to previous text generation work, we use BLEU, METEOR, and ROUGE_L to measure the fluency and topic relevance of the generated ideas.

answer_4.quote: We recruited more domain experts and non-experts in the field of computer science, geo-science (geology and geography), and medicine to conduct the Turing test.
answer_4.guideline: Participants are asked to read the machine-generated outputs and human-written texts and choose the real human-written text from a set of N-1 fake ones. Each participant is given instructions before the test.
